description: Source code implementing a Content Decryption Module (CDM) interface for DRM systems, including classes for managing sessions, buffers, and system factories, with plugin initialization and support checking.

classes.name: OCDMImplementation
classes.description: Main plugin class managing DRM system factories, sessions, and plugin lifecycle.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: RPC communication handler for external DRM system access.

classes.name: AccessorOCDM
classes.description: Provides access to DRM systems, manages sessions, and supports content decryption interface.

classes.name: BufferAdministrator
classes.description: Manages buffer allocation and release for DRM sessions.

classes.name: SessionImplementation
classes.description: Represents a DRM session, manages session data, and handles key updates and decryption.

classes.name: DataExchange
classes.description: Handles data exchange for DRM session buffers, runs in a separate thread.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Callback handler for DRM session events such as key messages and status updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, loads DRM factories, and sets up communication.

methods.name: Designators
methods.description: Returns designators for a given key system.

methods.name: Sessions
methods.description: Returns active sessions for a given key system.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a key system and content type are supported.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Retrieves the media keys interface for a key system.
